question: Which of the following nations was the part of 'Axis Powers' in World War II?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Germany.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Axis powers (**Germany, Italy, Japan**) were opposed by the Allied Powers (led by Great Britain, the U.S, and also the Soviet Union).
 
• Five other nations joined the Axis during Warfare II: Hungary, Romania, Bulgaria, Slovakia, and Croatia. 
 
• The decline and fall of the Axis alliance began in 1943.
 
• The Axis Powers **ruled much of Europe,geographical area and Africa**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​****World War II **or the **Second World War**, was a global war that lasted from **1939 to 1945.**
 
• It involved the overwhelming majority of the world's countries—including all of the nice powers—forming two opposing military alliances: the **Allies and therefore the Axis powers.**** **
 
• **Hitler's invasion of Poland in September 1939 drove Great Britain and France to declare war on Germany**, marking the starting of World War II.
